items.q: And so I was here six weeks with Morey Feld Peanuts Hucko and Maury Fell was with the World's Greatest Jazz Band.

ctx.x: See. And so, they came to New York and when they came to New York, well, Peanuts sent for me to Morey Feld's work in Maury Fell's place at -- here in Denver.
